name: Tachyon
description: A polyglot, file-system-routed full-stack framework shipped as one binary.

/.title: Tachyon — one project, web and native
/.description: A full-stack framework for many languages. Folders define the pages, and annotations define the server routes. Write HTML once. Run it in the browser and on every desktop and mobile target.
